title: Mushroom Ravioli in a Creamy Marsala Wine Sauce
description: This mushroom ravioli topped with a Marsala cream sauce is simple to make and will have mushroom lovers asking for seconds!
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon freshly chopped Italian parsley, or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and onion and saute until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Add Marsala wine and garlic; bring to a boil. Boil for 5 to 6 minutes, adding salt and pepper to taste. Stir in cream and simmer until thickened and heated through, about 5 minutes.

While the sauce is cooking, fill a large pot with about 4 quarts water. Set the burner to high and bring to a boil. Add ravioli to the boiling water. Cook until they float to the top of the water, 6 to 8 minutes, or according to package directions. Drain.
Pour a generous amount of sauce over hot ravioli and top with fresh parsley.
